_doc: How orch finds the newest version, the update notes and the update of a tool (toolupdates.py). Keyed by the tool's command name; the helper tools' recipes are in agents/updates.json. latest/notes: npm | pypi | github (releases; tag_prefix) | github_file (o/r/branch/path, '## x.y.z' sections) | brew / cask (Homebrew API). installs: how orch recognises an install from the real path of the command; the first that matches is used, none: the person updates it themselves.
